test_strategy.rationale: The requirement 'The system shall be easy to learn' is a qualitative usability goal that lacks numeric thresholds, explicit combined conditions, state sequences, or timing constraints. Per guidance, when none of the specific structured patterns apply, exploratory testing is selected.

test_cases.title: Exploratory Usability Charter: First-Time User Navigation and Learnability
test_cases.preconditions: A newly provisioned system instance with standard sample data and a participant who has received no prior training on the system.
steps: Provide the participant with basic core task objectives (e.g., locate a feature, complete a standard workflow).
Observe the participant attempting to navigate through the interface without assistance or documentation.
Note areas where the user encounters confusion, hesitates, or relies heavily on trial-and-error to complete tasks.
Gather qualitative feedback post-session regarding intuitive UI elements, tooltips, and overall onboarding experience.
test_cases.expected_result: The participant completes basic core tasks intuitively without external intervention, demonstrating clear UI affordances and minimal learnability friction.

test_cases.title: Exploratory Charter: Onboarding and Help Guidance Discovery
test_cases.preconditions: A fresh user profile logging into the system for the first time.
steps: Log into the application as a new user.
Explore available contextual help, tooltips, onboarding guides, or walk-throughs across different core screens.
Attempt to recover from intentional operational errors using only in-app guidance and help documentation.
Evaluate whether visual cues and help mechanisms effectively guide the user toward correct usage.
test_cases.expected_result: Contextual help and UI cues clearly explain workflow steps, allowing the user to self-correct and learn system features rapidly.
